description: Who LynkOmni is for (owner request 9 November 2026): the office services (accounting, invoicing, contacts, analytics and the rest of `office_families`) run the internal affairs of anyone: a person (household money or freelance work), a company of any size, or an organisation (non-profit, school, faith group, association or club, cooperative, public body). A workspace is a LynkOmni business record (LOOID) with an entity kind. The entity changes words, tabs, categories and suggested services only (presentation and setup); every record, event, price, limit and rule is the same for all. No till or registered device is needed for office work: it runs in any signed-in browser (LynkAcc, LynkInv and LynkCRM rule). Prices stay those of services/billing.py.
rules: One product for everyone: the entity never changes a price, a limit, an event, an identifier or a rule, only the words, tabs, categories and suggestions a person sees.

Categories are labels on the global chart of accounts (contract/chart-of-accounts.v1.json): each category posts to one global account, so books, reports and accountants read the same journal for every workspace.
Organisations may mark money as restricted (given for one purpose) or unrestricted; the mark is a label on the journal line and reports show each fund separately.
A person's household workspace is private to them and the people they invite; nothing in it is ever shared with a business, a supplier or LynkOmni partners.

Enterprise (approval steps, custom roles, sign-in with the organisation's own login system, audit log export) is the tier for large companies, groups and public bodies; every office service also works on Free.
